name: WPForms
description: WPForms is a WordPress form builder for contact forms, registrations, surveys, payments, file collection, and other structured submissions. Site owners manage fields, notifications, confirmations, integrations, entries, and reporting from WordPress.
agentUseSummary: Install WordPress 6.9 or later and WPForms Lite or Pro 1.9.9 or later on one public HTTPS site, create a dedicated WordPress Application Password for a user with only the required WPForms view capabilities, then let selected agents use five pinned reads for bounded form discovery, curated schemas, statistics, metadata-only entry summaries, and one exact entry. Relay does not mount cross-form entry search, field-bearing entry lists, arbitrary WordPress routes or abilities, notifications, confirmations, integrations, or writes.

credentialRequirements.label: WPForms site URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the public HTTPS WordPress site URL. Relay sends requests only to that site's WPForms WordPress Abilities API route and rejects private or local destinations.

credentialRequirements.label: WordPress username
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated WordPress user with only the WPForms view capabilities needed for the selected reads.

credentialRequirements.label: WordPress Application Password
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated revocable WordPress Application Password for Relay; never enter the user's normal WordPress password.

capabilities.label: Read forms and bounded entries
capabilities.description: Use five pinned read abilities for bounded form discovery, curated schemas, statistics, metadata-only entry summaries, and one exact entry.

allowed.label: Read WPForms
allowed.description: Read bounded form metadata, curated schemas, form statistics, entry summaries, and one exact entry from the configured site.

blocked.label: Change WPForms
blocked.description: Form, field, setting, entry, notification, confirmation, integration, and all other mutations are outside Relay's V1 contract.

blocked.label: Search broadly or list entry fields
blocked.description: Relay blocks cross-form search and forces entry summary lists to omit field values; field values require one exact entry ID.

blocked.label: Run another ability or WordPress route
blocked.description: Requests are pinned to five named WPForms read abilities on the configured site's WordPress Abilities API route.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Five pinned reads run directly. Cross-form search, field-bearing entry lists, arbitrary abilities, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one read tool with five pinned GET abilities through the encrypted site-bound WordPress Application Password.
Railway mounts one read tool with five pinned GET abilities through the encrypted site-bound WordPress Application Password.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned public WordPress 6.9+ site with WPForms 1.9.9+, dedicated view-capability user and Application Password, representative forms, or safe test entries is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: A site administrator verifies the supported WordPress and WPForms versions, provisions a dedicated user with only the required WPForms view capabilities, creates a dedicated revocable Application Password, saves the exact public site URL, username, and Application Password through Relay Console, then verifies site binding, all five reads, list bounds, entry-field minimization, IP removal, agent assignment, credential replacement, disconnect, provider-side revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: WPForms documents WordPress 6.9 and WPForms 1.9.9 requirements, Application Password authentication, GET-only read abilities, granular view capabilities, request schemas, pagination, Lite and Pro availability, and opt-in writes.
WordPress documents the authenticated /wp-abilities/v1 REST namespace and named ability execution model used by WPForms.
WordPress documents Application Passwords as revocable credentials for remote REST API authentication over HTTPS.
